Shipping an AI side project to $2k MRR

I launched a small transcript summarizer in March and it now brings in about two thousand dollars of monthly recurring revenue. The whole thing is a single Python worker, a Postgres table, and a landing page that took an afternoon to write.

The first version only supported one file format and had no billing at all. I emailed the twelve people who replied to my launch post and asked them to wire money manually. Nine of them did, which was the only signal I needed to keep going.

What actually moved the needle was writing about the failures in public. Each teardown post brought a handful of signups, and those signups converted far better than anything I got from paid channels. The lesson I keep relearning: distribution is a product decision, not a marketing afterthought.
